tasks.label: explain-open-task-state
args:
import sys, json
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, r'c:\NOVA')
import work_tree
from collections import Counter

rows=[]
for t in work_tree.list_trees():
    for b in work_tree.list_tree_branches(t.tree_id):
        bst=str(getattr(b.status,'value',b.status) or '').lower()
        if bst in {'complete','archived'}:
            continue
        for tk in work_tree.list_branch_tasks(b.branch_id):
            tst=str(getattr(getattr(tk,'status',None),'value',getattr(tk,'status','')) or '').lower()
            if tst in {'complete','dropped'}:
                continue
            rows.append((b.branch_id,b.title,tk.task_id,tk.title,str(getattr(tk,'created_at','')),str(getattr(tk,'updated_at',''))))

print('open_task_count',len(rows))
print('unique_branches',len({r[0] for r in rows}))
if rows:
    print('oldest_updated',min(r[5] for r in rows))
    print('newest_updated',max(r[5] for r in rows))

title_counts=Counter(r[3] for r in rows)
print('title_groups')
for title,count in title_counts.most_common(12):
    print(count,'|',title)

print('sample_oldest_10')
for r in sorted(rows, key=lambda x:x[5])[:10]:
    print(r[0],r[2],r[3],r[5])

print('sample_newest_10')
for r in sorted(rows, key=lambda x:x[5], reverse=True)[:10]:
    print(r[0],r[2],r[3],r[5])
